[SWS_DM_00243] Aging-related UDS DTC status byte processing
⌈
As a consequence of Aging, the DM shall set the following UDS DTC status bits
to 0:
• ’confirmedDTC’ unconditionally
• ’testFailedSinceLastClear’
conditionally,
if
statusBitHandlingTest-
FailedSinceLastClear is set to statusBitAgingAndDisplacement
⌋
